name: rotator cuff disease overview
title: Rotator cuff disease staged by how far the tendon has gone: stage I inflamed but intact, stage II partial-thickness and stage III full-thickness defects, and rotator cuff arthropathy with the humerus riding up to the acromion; treatment by stage once nonoperative care fails, with the examination and the causes in panels

root.title: Rotator cuff disease: how far has the TENDON gone?
lines: most common shoulder disorder · onset in the 40s · progressive
pain · weakness · restricted motion: ACTIVE motion << PASSIVE

panels.title: Treatment, every stage first
items: education · activity modification · pain management (nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs) · physiotherapy (muscle reconditioning) · injections
SURGERY when: pain persists · weakness · after an acute injury

panels.title: Why the tendon fails
items: INTRINSIC (usual): vascularity · tension overload · tendon degeneration
